description: The agent must: (1) Read raw_interview_notes.txt and identify all three challenges (leadership conflict, technology productization gap, market-technology mismatch); (2) Apply TRL assessment correctly — the notes describe a system prototype with small-scale field validation (TRL 6-7), NOT TRL 8-9, and must NOT prematurely classify it as production-ready given 40% yield; (3) Apply the dynamic leadership framework from SKILL.md — at 15 months the team is in the '成长期 (12-24 months)' requiring student/CEO-led operations; (4) Propose a 4-level communication mechanism including weekly meetings and monthly strategic alignment; (5) Recommend MVP-first / cost-performance balanced productization (80% perf + 50% cost philosophy); (6) Include the 3-stage market education strategy (认知→信任→需求); (7) Prioritize leadership conflict as the #1 most urgent issue given direct evidence of lost customers; (8) Address the Pre-A urgency (paid customer needed in 3-4 months); (9) Output the 5-section 《师生共创挑战应对方案》 document with all required sections (诊断/优先级/解决方案/时间线/风险预案). The proprietary traps are: the specific TRL 6-7 classification from field data, the 12-24 month = student-led rule, the exact 4-level communication structure, and the '80% performance + 50% cost' philosophy that a generic agent would not apply.
